location: RNS Institute of Technology Grounds, Bengaluru

summary.en: The sixth edition of the alumni cricket tournament.
summary.kn: ಹಿರಿಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಪಂದ್ಯಾವಳಿಯ ಆರನೇ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ.

body: The sixth edition of the Navodaya Cricket League was organized as an annual sports tournament, fostering camaraderie and healthy competition among alumni from different batches.
